title: startplasma-wayland overwrites $XKB_DEFAULT_*
line: Keyboard layout variables the user sets in .profile are no longer replaced by the system default when Plasma Wayland starts.
explanation: On Wayland, startplasma asks systemd-localed for the system keyboard model, layout, variant and options and exports them as XKB_DEFAULT_*. It did this unconditionally, so values the user had already exported before the session started (for example in .profile) were replaced by the system-wide defaults. The change only sets each XKB_DEFAULT_* variable from localed when it is not already set, as Nate suggested on the bug.

commits.message:
startplasma: don't overwrite XKB_DEFAULT_* variables that are already set

On Wayland, startplasma exported the keyboard settings from localed as
XKB_DEFAULT_* even when the user had already set them, e.g. in .profile,
so the system default won. Only set each variable when it isn't set yet.

BUG: 447203

media.caption: Session started with XKB_DEFAULT_LAYOUT=de and VARIANT=colemak: inside Plasma they are localed's us/dvorak
Same start with the fix: de/colemak are kept; MODEL (not set by the user) still comes from localed

review.text: One-line, per-variable check in startplasma so user-set XKB_DEFAULT_* survive, exactly what Nate proposed. Minimal and at the cause; unset variables still come from localed. Verification shows both the overridden and kept values.
